paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Ayala et al. (2014) Globular Cluster R-parameter bound: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, derived from 39 Galactic GCs using He abundance Y=0.2535 from low-metallicity H II regions (Aver et al.). Mass-independent bound valid for axion/ALP masses below a few keV (Primakoff production in stellar cores); encoded as flat line from effectively massless (1e-12 eV) up to ~10 keV, the stated validity range of GC bounds. Alternative bounds under different Y assumptions: 0.50e-10 (SBBN) and 0.76e-10 (solar Y). Astrophysical bound, no local DM density assumption. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
